name: next_app
description: Build a Next.js 14+ App Router application with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and API routes.
steps: Create project structure: app/, app/api/, components/, lib/, public/, types/
Write package.json with next, react, react-dom, typescript, tailwindcss, @types/*
Write tsconfig.json with strict mode and path aliases (@/* -> ./*)
Write app/layout.tsx — root layout with metadata, font, and Tailwind globals
Write each additional page as app/<route>/page.tsx
Write API routes as app/api/<route>/route.ts using NextRequest/NextResponse
Run: npm run build to verify no TypeScript or build errors
best_practices: Use App Router (app/ directory) — NOT pages/ directory
Server Components by default — add 'use client' only when needed (event handlers, hooks)
Collocate page-specific components inside the route folder
Use next/font for fonts — never import from Google Fonts directly
Use next/image for all images — never tags
Use next/link for navigation — never <a> tags for internal links
API routes: use NextRequest/NextResponse, NOT the old req/res pattern
Environment variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix for client-side, plain for server-only
Loading UI: create loading.tsx alongside every page that fetches data
Error handling: create error.tsx as a client component for error boundaries
Use TypeScript strict mode — no 'any' types without explicit justification
system_prompt_injection: You are building a Next.js 14 App Router application with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Use the app/ directory — NOT pages/. Server Components by default, 'use client' only when needed. Create ALL files. Write complete, working TypeScript — no 'any' types. After creating files, run npm install then npm run build to verify. Fix all TypeScript and build errors before finishing.
